command: Ordinary cargo +ohm check or cargo +ohm build -p ruff_text_size --locked --offline --message-format=json, with actual Ruff lock/manifest/checkout, same compiler, stable physically shared live canonical paths between arms, no flags/wrappers or trust overrides. Each payload toggles between stock and the full reverse historical edit in alternating directions. One rustc in each dirty command. The change in capability probes is part of the cost.
correctness: Train two distinct private complete stores for each arm/mode before scoring, 40 traced real Cargo commands plus Rust API clients. Both arms need one dirty full compiler, B no probe and C exactly one, all direct sources have four normal checksum rows and zero synthetic observer markers, no diagnostics, unchanged zero processes. Per source and endpoint every scored command must match all ordinary Rust metadata bytes, both codegen-unit ELF bytes and ordered stable member identities, and the link receipt outside its byte-for-byte entries for the two actually observed randomized .rcgu.o member names. Preserve raw archive and individual hashes. The historical removal must reject the ordinary caller with E0599, restoration must check and print 2-6 in native builds. Final unmodified command in every arm must be wholly fresh with all outputs raw identical. Any gate failure stops with no estimate.

historical_input.scope: cargo +ohm check or build -p ruff_text_size, full unmodified workspace/manifests/lock with only the complete one-file genuine historical change in a reversible read-only mount; exact cooperating Rust held identical in both arms. Receiver qualifies the API change, fresh roster and presence of physical capability probes. No effects may be computed from this traced setup.

placement: charlie-ohm-mono-bench, isolated tmpfs; CPUs 8,9,10,11 of the 16-core cgroup, private 1 GiB cap, at least 8 GiB free there and 1 GiB on durable scratch. Acquire same host release-build lock throughout. No observing full-study times.
statistics: Paired log ratio C/B and paired arithmetic wall delta in ms. Exact two-sided balanced permutation within edit/restore independently, 924^2 = 853776 assignments, Holm correction over check and build. Direction-stratified bootstrap, 20000 draws, fixed seeds 2026102701/2026102702. Report per-arm medians and both 95% intervals. Pass the small-overhead guard only when each endpoint upper one-sided 97.5% is below both +3% and +5 ms; performance-significant slowdown requires lower 95% percentage >0 and Holm P<0.05. This cohort may reveal a regression independent of the whole Ruff first-observer admissions.
timing: 24 paired blocks per endpoint, 48 dirty builds and 48 dirty checks in all. Six BC and six CB orders within each endpoint and each direction (12 edit and 12 restoration blocks). Same independently balanced interleaving of check vs build within direction. Time from directly invoking the rustup Cargo process through exit, on the assigned CPUs; fixture mounts, direct ordinary callers, audits and preflight are outside the timer. No early stopping, sample removal or replacements.
